newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia SBI index extends losses for third day.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia SBI index extends losses for third day.

text.p: The Slovenian SBI index extended hefty losses on Thursday, falling 6.19 percent and taking its losses to 21.8 percent in three days.

The SBI ended 85.4 points lower at 1,295.26 after hitting an all-time high of 1,655.35 on Monday. But traders said they expect the market to steady on Friday, as it had already recovered well from early morning lows.

In early trade, the SBI had fallen as low as 1,270.35 points as market participants continued to cash in profits amid general confusion over the central bank's ruling to restrict foreign trading activity.
Traders said share prices seemed to have bottomed out and that selling pressure continued to subside.
"Share prices have already started to pick up again during today's session and are expected to stabilise at current levels tomorrow," one trader said.
Issue A of drug company Lek was the most actively traded, falling 3.75 percent to 26,690 tolars on volume of 7,160 shares for total turnover of 181.3 million tolars.
Preferred shares of Dolenjska banka were the leading decliners, closing 14.76 percent lower at 12,360 on volume of 78 shares.
Overall 11 shares fell, seven rose and seven were untraded.
